name: bob
description: Scan your mail, see who connected you to whom, and thank the people who did it.

data_dir.title: Your Bob folder
data_dir.description: Where your network lives. Bob writes intros.csv, people.csv and network.html here. Never inside the plugin — plugin updates replace the plugin directory.

principal.title: Your email address
principal.description: The mailbox Bob reads. Bob uses it to tell an intro made FOR you from one you made. Bob reads one mailbox per run — list a second address and it will say so rather than quietly skip it. On the Gmail path the token decides, and this is checked against it.
